title: approvals: a request opened under `onEmptyApprovers: 'admin_rescue'` is in no one's pending queue — `listRequests` / `countRequests` have no arm that returns it to the callers who can decide it
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect measured at a public door (finding C-01, the queue half; the notification half was #22607). Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim. ## Read on objectstack `main` `f66fdc7973` `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`: - The `admin_rescue` branch (about `:3197`–`:3211`) logs "decidable only by a privileged admin", and the request opens with its unstaffed `position:

` literal as the slot. - `listRequests` (about `:7107`–`:7160`) narrows `approverId` through `approverRequestIds` (about `:6799`–`:6822`). That matches the slot against the addresses the caller supplies, so an admin's identities never equal an unstaffed `position:sales_manager`. - `visibleRequestIds` returns all rows to an override actor (`isOverrideActor`, about `:1623`). That is why the admin finds the request only under **All**. - `approverId` is parsed in REST at `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` about `:12474`–`:12525`; the allowed list is at about `:584`–`:596`. Measured on HotCRM: nobody's My Pending lists it, the bell reads 0, and a `lockRecord: true` record stays locked until someone looks under All. ## Done when - One server-side arm returns pending requests whose slate has no decidable holder **to a caller who may override them**, with the same `isOverrideActor` predicate the visibility read uses. ⛔ No second notion of "admin". - `listRequests` and `countRequests` both answer it, and the REST door accepts it as a declared query parameter. - Pins: - an `admin_rescue` request appears for an override actor; - it does not appear for a member; - CONTROL: a staffed request's queue is unchanged. **Lane:** `domain:services`, by the cross-domain exception path. The claim declares the `plugin-approvals` files and the REST parameter in `packages/rest`. **Foreseen follow-up, filed beside this:** the console's My Pending and the bell consume the arm (objectui, `pm:blocked` on this card). p2.
